title: The steps and their rules, and how to add a step
summary: Five steps are registered in v0.1-dev1. Manifest (intake): MF-MISSING, MF-PARSE, MF-SCHEMA, MF-PACKAGE, MF-NAME (package.name and version must give the directory name), MF-PUBLISH (publish.tree.path must be the package's own directory), MF-TESTS, MF-CWD, MF-PROGRAM, MF-PYTHON. HouseRules (inspect), read on code with comments, strings and ::resource text blanked: HR-PRIVATE (no private methods), HR-EXPOSE-FIRST, HR-RESULT (result as a variable), HR-PLUS-ZERO, HR-COMMENT (a slash-asterisk inside a comment that leaves it unclosed), HR-INDEX-LOOP (WARN: loop over the collection), HR-CREDITS (WARN). Pitfalls (inspect) asks Boston Crab's RexxPitfallChecker (oorexx_slam_bostoncrab_v0.24) rather than checking the same traps a second way: PF-P1 (a string followed at once by an opening parenthesis is a routine call), PF-P2 (a string followed at once by x or b that is not hex or binary), PF-P3 (two spellings of one name; a WARN for now, because the checker also counts message and directive names), PF-P4 (a loop variable that overwrites a use arg name). ModuleStamp (stamp): MS-MISSING (a class does not answer ~module_version and ~module_lastChanged), MS-VERSION (a stale stamp), MS-DATE (WARN: older than the file's last change, by git author date). KitRun (qualify), through Body Slam v0.2: each test run with a stand-in rexx, every program followed through its ::requires: KR-NOT-FOUND, KR-MISSING, KR-INVALID, KR-ENV, KR-GONE (WARN: the test deleted the program's directory before it could be followed), KR-OLDER and KR-TWO (WARN). A step's file header explains each of its rules.
invariants: A step is a subclass of WorkflowStep with id, stage, describe, skipReason(ctx), intends(ctx) and run(ctx, result). It returns findings through result~add; it never prints a verdict of its own.
A step reads files through ctx~source(rel), which reads each file once; it never scans raw text for code rules.
Adding a step is a new file in src/steps and one line in etc/steps.list. Nothing else changes.
A step that cannot load (a missing dependency) is listed as unavailable with the reason, and the others still run.
Every step class carries its own ::constant MODULE_VERSION and MODULE_LASTCHANGED.
procedure: Copy the shape of src/steps/ManifestStep.cls: header comment listing the rules, then the class.
Add tests with a fixture that breaks each new rule on a known line (tests/fixtures/bad_pkg_v0.4) and one that keeps them all (good_pkg_v0.2).
Run rexx tests/test_workflow.rex from the package directory, then run the Workflow on its own package: it must PASS.
